BiblicalUsage: Job remembers going out to the gate through the city, to take his seat where the town gathered, and Wisdom cries at the entry of the city, at the coming in at the doors. The word is simply the city — the place where life and judgment happen in public.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Wisdom does not hide in a corner: she stands at the city gate, and Job once sat where she cries.
